SeeDoctrine and Covenants 99:4. The Greek word translated as “receive” inMatthew 10:14and “receiveth” inMatthew 10:40can refer to the responsibilities of hosts to care for their guests (see Tremper Longman III and Mark L. Strauss,The Baker Expository Dictionary of Biblical Words[2023], 1062). Not receiving the Apostles may refer to a refusal to provide them with customary hospitality and to even listen to their message. It may be important to remember that Jesus taught James and John patience and restraint when He was not received by a village of Samaritans (seeLuke 9:51–56).
